name: Diverse Income Trust plc
tagline: A multi-cap UK equity income trust targeting attractive yields and sustainable dividend growth across 20+ holdings
hero_kpi_rationale: En tant que trust d'investissement axé sur le revenu, le rendement en dividendes est le KPI stratégique distinctif principal. Contrairement aux sociétés opérationnelles, ce véhicule d'investissement génère sa valeur principalement par la distribution de dividendes provenant d'un portefeuille diversifié multi-capitalisations. Le rendement en dividendes reflète directement la proposition de valeur fondamentale et la stratégie d'investissement du trust, avec un objectif explicite de surperformance relative aux pairs grâce à une croissance des dividendes supérieure.

kpis.explanation: Annual dividend per share divided by share price, representing the income return to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Core metric for income-focused investment trust strategy
kpis.description: Diverse Income Trust targets attractive yields through a multi-cap UK equity portfolio, with emphasis on stocks paying good and growing dividends. This is the primary value proposition of the trust, explicitly stated as delivering attractive income generation alongside capital appreciation potential.

kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth rate of dividends paid to shareholders, measuring revenue per share expansion.
kpis.signal: Key differentiator of multi-cap income strategy versus peer group
kpis.description: The trust's strategy explicitly targets dividend growth faster than most peers. Revenue per share expansion is expected to drive premium share price appreciation and outperformance versus comparable trusts. Source states: if trust generates better dividend growth than others in peer group, this will be reflected in better portfolio appreciation.

kpis.explanation: Total number of individual equity positions in the investment trust portfolio, demonstrating diversification breadth.
kpis.signal: Wide diversification across multi-cap universe reduces concentration risk
kpis.description: Multi-cap strategy provides genuine diversification across large, mid, and small-cap UK equities with at least 20+ holdings shown in top portfolio positions. Sector breakdown includes Financials (31.2%), Materials (13.2%), Industrials (12.9%), and Energy (9.3%), with smaller positions in Technology (4.6%). This broad diversification is explicitly identified as a golden rule of the trust's stock picking approach.

kpis.name_fr: Poids de la plus grande position
kpis.explanation: Portfolio weight of the single largest holding, indicating concentration risk management.
kpis.signal: Modest position weights indicate low concentration risk and genuine diversification
kpis.description: The largest holding (Kenmare Resources) represents only 2.5% of the portfolio. The trust maintains relatively modest weightings per position, allowing the strategy to run with relatively low risk metrics while delivering potential for strong returns. Top 20 holdings have weights ranging from 2.5% to 1.4%, demonstrating no significant concentration risk.

ai_positioning.summary: The company makes no mention of artificial intelligence strategy, technology, or investments. As a passive investment trust managed by Premier Miton with a focus on UK equity income, it has no active AI positioning.
evidence: No mention of AI in provided documents.
No references to AI-related technology company investments.
Portfolio strategy focused on dividend income and UK multi-cap equities, not innovation or technology disruption.
Information Technology sector represents only 4.6% of portfolio allocation as of February 2023.
